citations.claim: first violating step exists with controller force 46.38 exceeding limit 40

explanation: Shrunk 1-step scenario violates controller_force_limit: at step 1 controller applies 46.38 vs limit 40. Likely cause: state-feedback gains adapted to heavy plant (cart 2kg) produce large force from max initial offsets (x=0,v=0.5,theta=0.1,omega=0.3), and clipping to force_limit is not applied before check.
vision_note: The cart stays near the center of the track in both step 0 and step 1 with the pole leaning slightly to the right and almost no visible motion. No track exit, pole fall, or other dramatic failure is visible, as the force-limit excess is not visually apparent.
